decision.explanation: The question asks for the artist of the work 'David with the Head of Goliath'. The original sources provide evidence that both Caravaggio and Massimo Stanzione created works with this same title. Document D1S1 explicitly states that Caravaggio painted 'David with the Head of Goliath' in Rome. Document D5S1 and D7S1 confirm that Massimo Stanzione also created a painting with the same title, exhibited at the San Diego Museum of Art. These are distinct works by different artists with the same title, so both are valid answers. Leonardo da Vinci and Ribera are either incorrect or incidental in this context.
